# Plan Task

Create an implementation plan based on the research findings.

Before planning:

1. Confirm the relevant development standards.
2. Confirm project-specific requirements.
3. Identify flows/components to change, including affected connections and environments.

The plan must explicitly state:

- what will change
- why it will change
- which development standards apply
- target environment (Developer / Sandbox / Production) and justification if Production is used
- validation approach (e.g. test run, past trigger inputs, flow checker/preflight)
- risks

Do not implement yet.
